name: r/kettlebell wiki programming

source.note: Structure only: the swing-and-get-up beginner shape the wiki links to, written in our own words, no text reproduced. A training method is not copyrightable expression (17 U.S.C. 102(b), research/16 'The licence rule').

notes: Same session run 3x a week. Swings expressed as an EMOM (interval_s, sets = minutes); the ladder block shows the rep-step shape (sequence of rising then falling reps, run for its listed sets). Get-ups are prescribed per side in the source: `side: "each"` on the get-up block repeats its 6 sets once per side, alternating.

blocks.label: Swings (EMOM)
blocks.note: One set of 10 swings starts every 60s (interval_s); sets = EMOM minutes. Stages step the minute count up, not the swing weight.

blocks.label: Get-up
blocks.note: 3 singles per side, alternating, 6 total. `side: each` repeats the 3 sets once per side.

blocks.label: Swing ladder
blocks.note: One ladder trip (3-5-7-5-3 reps) counts as one set; run it 3 times.

blocks.label: Get-up
blocks.note: 3 singles per side, alternating, 6 total. `side: each` repeats the 3 sets once per side.
